type Big = `${bigint}`;
const zero: Big = '0';
const negativeZero: Big = '-0';
const decimal: Big = '-123456789012345678901234567890';
const hex: Big = '0x12';
const upperHex: Big = '0X1f';
const negativeHex: Big = '-0x12';
const binary: Big = '0b101';
const octal: Big = '0O77';
const id: `id-${bigint}` = 'id-0b11';
const all: Big[] = [zero, negativeZero, decimal, hex, upperHex, negativeHex, binary, octal];
console.log(all.map((text) => (text.startsWith('-') ? -BigInt(text.slice(1)) : BigInt(text))).join(' '), id);
type Num = `${number}`;
const spaced: Num = ' 1';
const radix: Num = '0x10';
const exponent: Num = '1e3';
const dotted: Num = '.5';
console.log([spaced, radix, exponent, dotted].map(Number).join(' '));
